FAQ

5://FAQ

Did you know that 60% of companies go bankrupt within six months after a cyberattack?

Cybersecurity isn’t just an IT issue – it’s a matter of survival. Our solutions protect you from the threats most businesses never see coming.

How much does a day of network downtime really cost you?

Every outage means lost productivity, lost revenue, and lost trust. We build networks engineered for reliability – because downtime isn’t an option.

What if your competitors start using AI before you do?

Our AI Infrastructure audit reveals if your network is ready for the future – and gets you there first.

Are you sure your data isn’t already on the darknet?

We identify security gaps and deploy protection that stops data leaks before they happen. You stay secure – not surprised.

Do you know who actually has access to your most sensitive information?

We design network architecture and access control that keep your data exactly where it should be – and nowhere else.

How much are you overpaying for a network that’s not optimized? 

Our network audit uncovers inefficiencies and wasted costs – and eliminates them fast.

How quickly could your company recover after a cyberattack?

With us, you’ve got a recovery plan, 24/7 support, and engineers who get you back online before it hurts.

Can your network handle growth or a surge in traffic from a new e-commerce launch?

We design scalable networks built to grow with your business – no bottlenecks, no surprises.

Who in your company is truly responsible for cybersecurity today?

The ultimate responsibility always lies with your management. We don’t replace it – we help you meet it.

How much time does your team waste fixing IT problems instead of growing the business?

Netcraft Solutions handles the tech. Your people focus on what actually drives revenue.
